transcription: Main article text only (site banner, menus and sidenav removed). The page H1 is served twice (site header and article); kept once as the '# Gas Properties Definitions' title line. Figure images not stored. The en dashes in the 'Large Scale Motion of a Gas – Macro Scale' and 'Individual Molecular Motion of a Gas – Micro Scale' headings kept as printed. Whitespace normalised, LF.
purpose: library: definitions of the gas state properties used across the Beginner's Guide gas pages — fluid dynamics framing; matter made of atoms with solid, liquid and gas states; gas mass characterised by molecular weight; extensive vs intensive properties; the macro-scale treatment (density, pressure and temperature averaged over many molecules) vs the micro-scale kinetic theory; diffusion; convection as ordered transport (a blast of cold weather); viscosity (stickiness) and compressibility of gases around moving objects. Fits a compare table of macro vs micro scale and of the property definitions, quiz cards, and a concept map; groundwork for the stored equation-of-state and specific-heat pages.
